name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer details
description: Mandatory declaration of manufacturer name and address, with packer and importer details when applicable.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a); legal basis from project specification, category-dependent import and declaration requirements.
notes: This rule is treated as a legal-declaration check; if applicable import details are uncertain, the output must say Missing Declaration or Unable to Verify, not 'Violation Confirmed'.

name: Common / generic name of commodity
description: Common or generic product name must be stated; for multi-product packages each product should be identified.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) and project notes on multi-product packaging.
notes: For multi-product packages, the engine can detect multiple product names where structured data includes them.

name: Net quantity
description: Net quantity must be declared with a valid numeric quantity and acceptable unit basis.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c); examples include g, kg, mg, ml, L, litre, liter, cm, m and count/number where relevant.
notes: Malformed or unrecognized units should surface as Potential Non-Compliance; low OCR confidence should yield Unable to Verify.

name: Manufacture / pre-packing / import date
description: Date requirement is category-dependent; food-specific rules may override or modify the generic requirement.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) and project note: food-specific exception / category-dependent date rule interaction.
notes: The engine must not apply one universal date rule to all food products. If food-specific category information is absent, return Requires Human Verification or Unable to Verify.

name: Retail sale price / MRP
description: MRP or maximum retail price declaration is required where applicable; category- and state-law-specific exceptions may apply.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e); project notes specify alcoholic beverage MRP may be governed by State Excise laws and not by a uniform generic rule.
notes: For alcoholic beverages, generic MRP treatment may be overridden by category/state-law dependency.

name: Month and year of manufacture / packing / import
description: Where applicable, the package must show the month and year of manufacture, packing or import in a recognizable format.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(f); project notes say do not apply blindly to food products where food-specific rules govern the date requirement.
notes: Accept MM/YYYY, MM-YYYY, or month + year literals, with sanity checks for plausibility.

name: Consumer complaint / contact information
description: Consumer complaint contact must include the name, address, telephone and email where available.
notes: Recognize labels such as Consumer Care, Customer Care, Customer Service and Helpline.

name: Minimum numeral / letter dimensions
description: Minimum dimensions depend on package quantity and display panel conditions and cannot be definitively measured from a normal photograph without calibration.
legal_reference: Rule 7(2)-(3); project note: requires calibrated scale/reference or a reliable vision measurement, otherwise Requires Human Verification.
notes: If no calibrated scale/reference is available, the rule must return Requires Human Verification; do not invent measurements.

name: Principal display panel placement
description: Required declarations should appear on the principal display panel; this is checked through source-image and panel metadata.
notes: If clearly found on the expected panel: Compliant. If likely wrong panel: Potential Non-Compliance. If insufficient image metadata: Requires Human Verification.

name: Quantity declaration clear space
description: The quantity declaration should have the required clear space around it; visual layout heuristics are allowed but not definitive legal conclusions.
notes: If CV information is unavailable, return Requires Human Verification; if clear-space analysis flags an issue, return Potential Non-Compliance.

name: Returnable beverage bottle MRP placement
description: Returnable beverage bottle MRP may be on the crown cap or bottle, and should not be incorrectly treated as missing solely because it is absent from the main bottle label.
notes: Support source_image = cap while allowing the MRP to be found on the bottle or cap.

name: Declarations legible and prominent
description: Mandatory declarations must be legible, prominent, and readable without undue effort.
notes: Low readability or low OCR confidence should lead to Unable to Verify; clear visual unreadability is Potential Non-Compliance.

name: MRP contrast conspicuous
description: MRP must contrast conspicuously with the background.
notes: If no computer-vision measurement is available, return Requires Human Verification.

name: Net quantity contrast conspicuous
description: Net quantity must contrast conspicuously with the background.
notes: If no measurement is available, return Requires Human Verification; otherwise insufficiency is Potential Non-Compliance.

name: Liquid display / readability through liquid
description: Declarations cannot be made so that they must be read through the liquid commodity, especially in beverage bottles.
notes: A suspected issue may be Potential Non-Compliance; when the image cannot establish this, return Requires Human Verification.

name: Outer wrapper / container declaration
description: If an outside wrapper or container exists, required particulars should generally appear on the outside unless a transparent wrapper permits readable inner declarations.
notes: No wrapper => Compliant/not applicable. Transparent wrapper with readable inner declarations => Compliant. Opaque wrapper without required declarations => Missing Declaration or Potential Non-Compliance depending on evidence.

name: Mandatory particulars in Hindi or English
description: Mandatory particulars must be in Hindi (Devanagari) or English; additional languages are permitted.
notes: If only unsupported languages are detected, Potential Non-Compliance. If OCR cannot detect language, Unable to Verify.

name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer identification and complete address
description: Separate verification of manufacturer, packer and importer identity and the complete address of the relevant responsible entity.
notes: This is a separate rule result from PC-001 because the specification lists it separately.

name: Net quantity excludes wrappers and packaging material
description: Net quantity must exclude wrappers and packaging material; this generally needs physical measurement data rather than photo-only evidence.
notes: If the engine has only a photograph and no physical measurements, it must return Requires Human Verification rather than claiming proof.

name: Quantity basis matches commodity type
description: The quantity basis must match the commodity type: mass for solids, volume for liquids, length for linear goods, area for area-based products and number/count for number-based goods.
legal_reference: Rule 12; project specification lists mapping by commodity type and sale basis.
notes: If the product category is unknown, return Unable to Verify.

name: Quantity declaration not misleading or exaggerated
description: The quantity declaration must not create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression.
notes: Look for suspicious phrases in a configurable keyword list; do not output 'Violation Confirmed'.

name: Number / count declaration
description: For commodities sold by number, the declared quantity basis must use an accepted count format such as N or U or a clear count notation.
notes: This rule only applies when the product is sold by number or count.

name: Special commodity quantity / dimension declaration (sheets / fabric / container), not general food
description: Low-priority special commodity rules for sheets, fabric-type goods, container-type commodities and similar category-specific goods.
legal_reference: Rules 14-17; project note says these are low priority and should not be applied to general food packages.
notes: category_specific: true; default_enabled: false; the engine should evaluate only when the commodity category requires it.

name: Special commodity declaration rule
description: Low-priority special commodity declaration requirement for category-specific goods.
notes: Not applicable to ordinary food; disabled by default.

name: Special commodity declaration rule
description: Low-priority category-specific special commodity declaration rule.
notes: Disabled by default and only activated for the applicable commodity class.

name: Special commodity declaration rule
description: Low-priority category-specific dimension declaration rule for designated special commodity classes.
notes: Will not trigger for ordinary food unless the product class indicates otherwise.

name: Retail / wholesale dealer workflow compliance
description: Dealers must not sell, distribute, display or store non-compliant packaged commodities where compliance remains unresolved.
notes: This is a workflow/compliance rule rather than an image-label rule. It is not a criminal legal conclusion.

name: Retail sale price must not exceed declared MRP
description: Actual sale price must not exceed the declared retail sale price or MRP.
notes: If actual sale price is unavailable, return Unable to Verify.

name: MRP not obliterated / smudged / altered
description: The MRP must not be obliterated, smudged or altered by dealers or other handlers.
notes: If image quality is insufficient, return Requires Human Verification; if MRP alteration is suspected, Potential Non-Compliance.

name: Physical sampling / statistical average / MPE testing
description: Physical sampling, statistical average and maximum permissible error testing require physical measurements and cannot be trusted from a photograph alone.
notes: This rule must return Requires Human Verification unless structured physical measurement data is explicitly supplied.
